treeClearanceEvidence: Nine stems strictly inside roof/wall footprints, plus six strictly inside the separately traced paved courtyard. The orthophoto shows continuous paving without trees there. No stem is selected merely because its crown approaches a roof.
courtyardEvidence: Traced inside the continuous paved/stone foreground of the 2025 0.16m ortho crop, north up. Approximately 0.5-1 m boundary uncertainty. It stops west of the central annex and south of the car park approach; surrounding lawn is not included.
reproducibility: Tree deletes are persistent existing GolfMap tree edits and survive survey/export/replant. Preserve conflicts rather than replacing manual edits. Lower vegetation clearance is a course-local post-export overlay on mask PNGs, and persists in Unity via golfmap.zones.patch; every full/overlapping zones export must be followed by rerunning this script --zones --apply and the patch import. Database zone geometry is unchanged. No mask groups, rules, terrain or shaping layers change. This overlay is documented and repeatable, not integrated into Update vegetation.
